LightningComponentBundle.description: Renders a PDFforce template against input data, with paged preview, signature capture, save, and submit-as-PDF.

property.name: templateId
property.label: Template Id
property.description: Id of the template record whose attached docx-export HTML should be rendered.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Record context for the renderer. Saved drafts are keyed by recordId+templateId, and Submit defaults to attaching the PDF here. On community record pages this is auto-populated via the {!recordId} expression; leave blank to inherit it.

property.name: submitRecordId
property.label: Submit Target Record Id
property.description: Optional. When set, Submit attaches the generated PDF to this record id instead of the renderer's own Record Id.

property.name: fileName
property.label: File Name
property.description: Base file name (no extension) used for the submitted PDF.

property.name: pageNumberPosition
property.label: Page Number Position
property.description: Where to render the Page X of Y footer in each page's bottom margin band. Choose 'none' to suppress page numbers.

property.name: customSpinner
property.label: Use Custom Spinner
property.description: When true, renders the component's CSS spinner instead of the standard Lightning spinner.

property.name: showPreview
property.label: Show PDF Preview
property.description: When true, the generated PDF is displayed in-place after generation.

property.name: autoSave
property.label: Auto Save
property.description: When true, the document is saved automatically once rendering completes.

property.name: autoSaveToCurrentRecord
property.label: Auto Save to Current Record
property.description: When true, the auto-saved file is linked to the current Record Id.
